scope: Investigate endpoint and transit reliable transport queues alongside complete original audio/video/file congestion workload.
workload: 360 s; three real codec participants; six PCM directions; shared neutral FIFO 1024 kbit/s each direction; three encrypted 512-KiB files; original <200-ms gate.
comparison_limits: Same optimized FFI package/features, media library, fixture/policy and source clocks. Each run retains its independent failed verdict.
The all-reliable capture includes up to three OS stack profiles and is diagnostic, not a controlled performance comparison.
Baseline contains the same four pre-existing multi-device security worktree edits as diagnostic builds.
One control and one instrumented observation do not establish whether instrumentation affects severity.

group-baseline-release-full-360.ordinal_delay_limitations: All expected transitions match; includes capture/encode/network/decode, not speaker hardware latency.
reliable_metric_limitations: Stream retained includes unacknowledged and selectively acknowledged storage; it is not the unsent-byte count.
Actor and record credits overlap; do not sum them as disjoint payload.
100-ms samples do not exclude sub-sample bursts.

findings.large_pre_admitted_reliable_queue: Not established. Sampled retained storage is only a few kilobytes; 100-ms snapshots cannot rule out shorter bursts.
findings.logging: OS profiles observe network receivers blocked in NodeLogger/stderr. Pipe control retains logs and avoids >25-ms runner stages; its final verdict remains FAIL.
findings.video_pause: Source 0 pauses at the one-fps floor after fresh recovery events near 344/345 s. Another event near 353 s leaves fewer than the required 12 healthy measurements before capture end; this is not proof of a permanent latch.
unqualified: Corrected pipe capture still needs full route/topology and video qualification.
Human speech loudness/intelligibility and actual headset routing remain deferred.

sink_comparison.pipe_wrapper_failure: Intercepted read_text of native.log after capture; final route/topology were not checked. Archived failure and wrapper retained.
sink_comparison.limits: A single sequential pair with separate fresh identities and random file bytes supports the logging-contestion diagnosis, but does not quantify its effect on real device calls. Pipe capture still has video freezes and cannot qualify the goal.
